approved_increase.notes: PROPOSED: 9% electricity consumption increase (availability charge +6%) in the 2026/27 budget, deliberately limited to ~9.01% although the cost-of-supply study indicated 19.8%. Recheck 2026-07-05: NERSA published Newcastle's draft tariffs for public comment 9 Apr 2026; EXCO considered the final 2026/27 budget 20 May 2026 — final adopted electricity % not literally reported. An unverified newcastle.gov.za page mentions 'NERSA approved tariffs range 5.4%–9.4%' but its year could not be confirmed — treat as unverified.
